summary: Reproduced the same-corpus add/remove overlap in ExternalCorpusManager: remove returned success while the worker load was deliberately held pending. The manager now rejects removal of that corpus until the pending load has been committed, while removal of a different loaded corpus and removal after load completion remain supported. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36517 contains a related open candidate but was not present in the prepared base.

tests.what_was_measured: Deterministic in-progress load overlap against the checked-out ExternalCorpusManager. The same-corpus remove incorrectly returned success=True; the different-corpus and post-load boundary cases passed. Raw output: reports/j-bbc57662990b/test_before_fix.log

The same-corpus pending removal is rejected without calling the worker remove method; different-corpus removal during the load and same-corpus removal after completion still succeed. 3 tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-bbc57662990b/test_after_fix.log
Existing NGRAM corpus behavior and HTTP endpoint mocks. 42 tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-bbc57662990b/test_ngram_corpus.log
Formatting/lint tooling availability only; the prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module. git diff --check passed separately.

gpu_execution_evidence: The defect and correction are scheduler control-plane state handling around a background Python thread; no GPU kernel or numerical output participates in the reproduced transition. No unrelated GPU smoke was used as evidence.
remaining_limitations: The exact Qwen3-4B HTTP reproduction was not run because those model weights were not provided; the regression directly exercises the actual ExternalCorpusManager implementation and synchronizes the reported overlap deterministically.
The qualified tiny Llama serving fixture was not used because it can only validate transport/engine execution and would not add evidence beyond the directly tested scheduler lifecycle transition.
The prepared interpreter lacks ruff, so ruff format/lint checks could not be run; git diff --check succeeded.
